tasks.short: Write reports of activities, and maintain files of impoundments and dispositions of animals.

steps.what: Write field notes of the day's activities on the call
Type activity reports from those field notes

loop.input: the field notes she wrote in s1
loop.check: each sentence states a fact that is already in those notes
loop.stop: a sentence adds a fact the notes do not contain, or she rejects the draft, and she then types that report herself
loop.why_not_simpler: The notes are free text, so a blank form cannot write the narrative

steps.what: Check each report sentence against the field notes
Sign the activity reports she has accepted
maintain files of impoundments and record dispositions of animals

tasks.design: A draft on {DOCS} writes activity report sentences from the call notes she already logged. She checks that each sentence matches a note, then signs that accepted version. She still maintains the impoundment file and records each disposition herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The notes are free text, and she types the narrative afterwards by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: The notes already hold the facts, so a bounded draft can propose only sentences she can accept or reject.
tasks.still_hard: Thin notes, a disposition decided days later, and any fact that was never written down.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which sentence overstates what happened on the call.
tasks.altitude: Retyping the activity narrative is shorter. She still signs the report and still records impoundments and dispositions. She gains no right to change a disposition by signing.

reach.task: Keep the holding log in the same words as the signed activity report
reach.learn: Which disposition codes the shelter already uses

evidence.claim: She writes field notes on the call, then types an activity report from those notes. That second typing is the work removed.
The privacy code names the dossier fields as assignment, method and reason, findings, and photos, and the investigator signs. The draft does not sign, and it adds no fact the notes lack.

assumptions: Today she writes field notes on the call and later types activity reports from those notes. That second typing is the work this change removes.
Checking the sentences, signing the report, and maintaining files of impoundments and dispositions stay full time. The signature is not removed work.
The disposition is entered when she decides it, once. That entry is not a second writing of the narrative.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added. The dossier fields are already fixed.
If the office already writes the narrative once in the same file as the notes, none of this time comes back.
Of the task, the notes are 22, typing the reports is 24, the sentence check is 18, the signature is 14, and the impoundment file is 22.
unknowns: Whether field notes and the activity report are already the same entry.
Whether the shelter, rather than her, records the disposition.
research_questions: How often does she type activity reports from separate field notes?

already_counted.description: She still writes the notes, checks every sentence, signs, and maintains the impoundment file.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

approvals.approved_version: the activity report she accepted in s3, including any sentence she rewrote there

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low is zero when the notes are too thin and she still types the narrative, or the narrative was already the only entry. The high is 14 when she still rewrites the findings sentences on most reports, after no extra upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate reports of animal attacks or animal cruelty, interviewing witnesses, collecting evidence, and writing reports.

steps.what: Investigate reports of animal attacks by attending the scene
interviewing witnesses about what they saw happen
collecting evidence from the animal and the place
writing reports on whether cruelty is shown

tasks.design: She still goes to the scene, interviews witnesses, and collects evidence. She still writes the cruelty report and decides whether the case is made. No second entry is part of this task, so none of that time is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The scene, the witness, and the animal are in front of her, and the finding is her judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in the recorded pattern removes the visit, the interview, or the finding.
tasks.still_hard: A witness who will not speak, an animal that cannot be handled, and a finding that may go to a prosecutor.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether what she saw and heard is cruelty.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still attends the scene, interviews, collects evidence, and writes the report.

reach.task: Interview a witness to an attack once the case is criminal
reach.learn: Which questions stay with the detective

evidence.claim: The investigation is the scene, the witness, the evidence, and her finding. Those stay with her.
Crime prediction based only on profiling is prohibited. This task is the scene, the interview, and her own report, not a profile.

assumptions: The scene, the interview, the evidence, and the cruelty report stay full time. No step is removed.
The report is the record of her finding. It is not a second typing of a log this task already keeps.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
A case the detective already owns is not her time. The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: How often a cruelty case is handed to a detective before she writes.
research_questions: Which cruelty reports does she write, and which does a detective write?

already_counted.description: She still attends, interviews, collects evidence, and writes the report.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept for the investigation. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still investigates. A case a detective already leads is not her time, and no step here is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Contact animal owners to inform them that their pets are at animal holding facilities.

steps.what: Contact begins with the animal file and the tag
outputs: name or number on the tag

steps.what: Look up the owners named on the tag or chip
inputs: name or number on the tag

steps.what: inform their household by phone or at the door
Name the holding facilities and the collection hours

tasks.design: She still reads the tag, finds the owners, and tells them by phone or at the door which holding facility has the pet. That talk stays hers. No separate notice is typed, so no second message is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The owner is reached by a tag, a chip number, or a knock at the door, and the news is spoken.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing recorded here removes the call or the visit. A register she already searches is not a second entry.
tasks.still_hard: A tag with no number, a household that does not answer, and a promise of release she must not make.
tasks.human_edge: She hears whether this household can collect the animal, and she does not promise a release.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still finds the owners and still tells them where the pet is.

reach.task: Tell a resident where an animal is held when police took the call
reach.learn: Which calls the police already make so she does not repeat them

evidence.claim: She reads the tag or chip, finds the owners, and tells them by phone or at the door. That contact stays with her.
Telling the wrong household, or promising a release she cannot make, stays her responsibility.

assumptions: Finding the owners and telling them stay full time. The talk is spoken, not a second typed notice.
A search she already does in one register is not removed work.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
If the shelter already called the owner, that time is not hers. The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: Whether a chip number is already matched to an owner before she starts this task.
research_questions: How often is the owner already known from the tag, with no further search?

already_counted.description: She still reads the tag, finds the owners, and tells them where the pet is.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept for owner contact. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still contacts the owners. A call the shelter already made is not her time, and no step here is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Educate the public about animal welfare, and animal control laws and regulations.

steps.what: Educate the person who asked about a local rule
Explain animal welfare in words that fit this case
State the animal control rule that applies here
Answer the public on regulations for this animal

tasks.design: She still explains animal welfare and the control rule to the person in front of her, and she still answers until they understand. The talk stays in the room or at the event. No handout is produced in this task, so no drafting time is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The explanation depends on the animal and the question in front of her.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing recorded here replaces that explanation. She does not keep a second written version in this task.
tasks.still_hard: A local rule that differs by municipality, and a resident who wants a promise about their own animal.
tasks.human_edge: She matches the rule to this animal and this question, and she stops when the person has it.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still educates the public on welfare and on the control rules.

reach.task: Explain a local animal rule at a public meeting
reach.learn: Which questions the police already answer so the talks do not clash

evidence.claim: The education is a live explanation of welfare and the local rule. She still gives it.
A wrong statement of the local rule stays her responsibility. This digest does not measure that talk.

assumptions: The explanation and the answers stay full time. No step is removed.
This task does not include a handout or a second written version, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
A talk another officer already gives is not her time. The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: Whether some of these talks are already given by a police officer or a shelter volunteer.
research_questions: How often is this education a live answer, rather than a document someone else published?

already_counted.description: She still explains welfare, states the rule, and answers the public.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept for the talks. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still educates the public. A talk another officer already gives is not her time, and no step here is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Activity reports take less retyping. Scene work, cruelty interviews, owner calls, and public explanations stay the week. She gains no right to seize an animal or to close a cruelty case.
skills_to_grow: Reject a report sentence that adds a fact the notes do not contain.
Keep a cruelty interview on what the witness saw.
Tell an owner where the pet is without promising a release.
role.ambitious_version: Field notes land as the activity report she only corrects, and the holding line is written once when the animal comes in. She still goes to the scene, still interviews, still calls the owner, and still decides the disposition.
